question: D, E, F, G, L, M and N are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only two people sit between F and L when counted from the left of L.N sits third to the left of M.G sits to the immediate right of M.G sits second to the left of F.E is not an immediate neighbour of N. Who sits third to the right of D?
solution:
Given: 

D, E, F, G, L, M and N are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Only two people sit between F and L when counted from the left of L.

G sits second to the left of F. G sits to the immediate right of M

N sits third to the left of M.
